column1: # The toolbars whose buttons do not all fit (UI-6, docs/port-notes/UI-6.md; UI-OVF, docs/port-notes/UI-OVF.md; ToolBarFitTests): toolbar,

# >> overflow button. Written by the test with OPMS_UI6_WRITE_OVERFLOW=1. Every button the code can add is counted (also those behind a

# right end opens a drop-down with each of them (same text, icon, enabled and checked state, click, sub-menu). The main menu has no overflow
# button and must fit (no menu row).
